editorial.blurb: A no-frills Chinatown institution serving authentic Hong Kong–style barbecue with juicy roast duck, crispy pork belly, and generous portions that speak for themselves.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the whole roasted duck with sauce for pairing, and ask for complimentary tea — regulars praise the juicy, never-dry preparation and the friendly service makes it worth the visit during lunch or early dinner.
